card.name: Geriatric use sentence: clinical experience has not identified
card.fires_on: Words in the standard geriatric-use sentence "Other reported clinical experience has not identified differences in responses between the elderly and younger patients." It is strongest on "has" right after "clinical experience".

modes.label: "has" after clinical experience
modes.description: The word "has" following "Other reported clinical experience" in the geriatric-use paragraph.

modes.label: Later words in the same sentence
modes.description: Words such as "not", "identified" and "between" further along in that same sentence.

card.plain: It lights up on the stock label sentence saying clinical experience has not found differences between elderly and younger patients.
